verdict.rationale: LegalZoom's docs confirm it can file corporation formation (S corp/C corp) online with flat fees and error correction guarantees, which covers the core 'filing' part of a Delaware startup incorporation, but there is no evidence of Delaware-specific service, bylaws drafting, or initial board resolutions/approvals being part of the package (those items are only mentioned for LLC operating agreements, not corporations). Community feedback focuses on LLC formation cost complaints, not corporate incorporation completeness. Missing for 10: Delaware-specific incorporation flow, bylaws generation, initial board consent/resolution documents, and independent verification that these are actually delivered.
